artworks.title: The Friendly Mr. John Greenwood
artworks.artist: William Pether
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 17 x 12.5 cm (6 11/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man from the chest up. He is slightly turned to his right, facing the viewer. The man has a gentle expression with a calm gaze, prominent nose, full cheeks, and a slight double chin. His hair is white or gray and styled away from his face. He is wearing a dark, buttoned coat over a white, high-collared shirt. The clothing suggests a formal style of the late 18th to early 19th century. The portrait is surrounded by a frame resembling a wooden surface. Below the portrait is an artist's palette with the inscription, "The Friendly Mr. Greenwood died 1792," and the painter's signature "M. Wether Es". The background is a solid, neutral tone.

artworks.title: An Hermit
artworks.artist: William Pether after Joseph Wright
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man seated in a cave, holding a skull. He has long white hair and a beard, wearing flowing garments blending with the shadows. A lantern illuminates the scene, revealing more bones on a rock nearby. Two younger figures, dressed in simple tunics, are partially visible to the left. The cave opens into a dark, moonlit landscape with trees and clouds.

artworks.title: Richard Tompson
artworks.artist: Francis Place after Gerard Soest
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man's head is slightly turned with his gaze towards the viewer. He has strong facial features, long wavy hair, and wears dark formal clothing with a high collar. The background is plain and dark, and there are inscriptions below the portrait.

artworks.title: Sa Ga Yeath Qua Pieth Tow, King of the Maquas
artworks.artist: John Simon after John Verelst
artworks.description: The image features a man standing confidently in a natural setting. He is posed with one hand on his hip and the other resting on a rifle or musket standing upright beside him. The man has a stoic expression with high cheekbones and a strong jawline. His hair is styled pulled back with loose strands framing his face. He is dressed in a loincloth and draped cloak with decorative edges, and fabric tied around his feet. The man has intricate body paint or tattoos on his face and torso, fur or pom-pom-like ornaments at each side of his head, and a pouch hanging from his belt. A wolf-like creature is shown beside him, appearing to growl. The background is a dense forest with trees, bushes, and a small figure in the distance.

artworks.title: Tee Yee Neen Ho Ga Row, Emperor of the Six Nations
artworks.artist: John Simon after John Verelst

artworks.title: Ho Nee Yeath Taw No Row, King of the Generethgarick
artworks.artist: John Simon after John Verelst
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a forest setting. The individual has a confident stance, holding a bow. They have distinct facial features with markings, tied hair, and wear a cloak, belt, and laced footwear. A canine companion stands by their feet. The background includes dense foliage, trees, and another human figure engaging in an activity.

artworks.title: Etow Oh Koam, King of the River Nation
artworks.artist: John Simon after John Verelst
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently with one hand on his hip and the other holding a large staff or club. He has high cheekbones, facial tattoos or markings, pulled-back hair tied with ties on both sides, and is dressed in a draped robe or tunic, a cloak over his shoulders, and a belt holding a sword or dagger. He wears moccasin-like footwear fastened around the ankles. A turtle is at his feet, with a small object nearby. The background features a forest setting with large trees and dense foliage.

artworks.title: William Johnston, Marquess of Annandale
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.medium: mezzotint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated and facing slightly to his left. The man has a calm expression with well-defined facial features, including full cheeks and a straight nose. His hair is long, curly, and dark, cascading down his shoulders. He is wearing elaborate clothing, featuring a richly patterned jacket adorned with decorative elements and a white, lace-like cravat around his neck. The background is an ornate frame with symbols and insignia, featuring crowned emblems and crests surrounded by scrolls and ribbons. The image includes inscriptions identifying the man as William Marquis of Annandale and detailing his titles and roles, with decorative elements throughout the background.

artworks.title: Robert Cecil
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to the side with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a rounded face, prominent eyebrows, a subtle smile, long and curly hair cascading over his shoulders. He is dressed in a formal outfit typical of the era, including a dark cloak over a lighter garment with a tied cravat. There are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is plain with an oval vignette that accentuates the subject.

artworks.title: Nicola Cosimo
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.dimensions: overall (cut inside platemark): 34.5 x 25 cm (13 9/16 x 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and looking at the viewer. He has curly shoulder-length hair and a neutral expression. He is dressed in formal attire, holding a violin and a bow. The background is plain and dark, with a decorative inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Godfrey Kneller
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned facing forward with his body slightly turned to the left while looking directly at the viewer. The man has full facial features, with a slightly rounded face adorned with long, curly hair that flows down past his shoulders. He is dressed in an elegant, high-collared shirt beneath a flowing, draped garment. His right hand is visible, gesturing towards the center of his chest. The background is a simple, darkened oval that frames the portrait. Text is displayed beneath the portrait, providing identification and attribution details.

artworks.title: John Locke
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image shows a torso-length portrait of a man seated with his body facing slightly to the side, but his head turned towards the viewer. He has a serene expression with distinguished facial features including prominent cheekbones and an aquiline nose. His hair is light, shoulder-length, and wavy, framing his face gently. The man is dressed in a robe or loose-fitting garment that drapes over his shoulder, giving the impression of formality. The clothing beneath appears to be a high-collared shirt. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with an oval shape encircling the subject. At the bottom of the image is a dedication that reads: “Johannes Locke Ob. A. D. 1704. Ætat. 72.”

artworks.title: John Smith
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features with high cheekbones, a straight nose, and full lips. He has medium-length, dark hair and wears a dark robe over a high-collared garment. One hand rests on a rolled paper held by the other hand, featuring an illustration of someone's face. The background is dark.

artworks.title: John Hay, Earl of Tweeddale
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with curly hair, standing facing the viewer. The individual is wearing a cloak with ermine fur, and the background is a dark oval within a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Sir Christopher Wren
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an older man's upper body. He is positioned slightly to the side with his head turned towards the viewer, displaying a neutral expression. The man has long, wavy hair that cascades over his shoulders, with prominent curls framing his face. His facial features include a prominent nose and high cheekbones, and his eyes are looking directly at the viewer. He is dressed in formal, period clothing consisting of a dark coat with large decorative buttons, a white cravat tied at the neck, and a waistcoat. The background is a simple, dark oval shape that contrasts with the figure. There are no visible accessories or objects being held in his hands.

artworks.title: John, Earl of Mar, Lord Erskine
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.medium: mezzotint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with strong facial features and long curly hair, wearing ornate armor and a high-collared shirt fastened with a cravat. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative oval frame with coats of arms and heraldic symbols. The background features engravings, ribbons, and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Queen Mary
artworks.artist: John Smith after Jan van der Vaart

artworks.title: Thomas Murray
artworks.artist: John Smith after Thomas Murray
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up, faced slightly to his right. He has a round face with prominent cheeks, a straight nose, and full lips. His hair is curly and voluminous, flowing down around his shoulders. The man wears a luxurious garment with billowing sleeves and a white cravat at his neck. His left hand rests on the garment near his chest. The background is a neutral dark tone, and an oval frame surrounds the subject. At the bottom of the image is elegant script that reads "Tho: Murry Pictor."

artworks.title: Godfried Schalcken
artworks.artist: John Smith after Godefridus Schalcken
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person standing with one arm resting on a ledge and the other holding a lit candle. They have a serene expression and full, curly hair. The person is wearing an elegant robe and a high-collared shirt, with decorative elements. The background includes architectural elements like a column and classical sculptures.

artworks.title: John Lord Sommers
artworks.artist: John Smith after Jonathan Richardson, Sr.
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man who is facing forward. His position appears to be seated or standing with his upper body directly toward the viewer. The man's facial features are detailed, with a slightly round face, prominent nose, and lips that are closed. His hair is long and curly, extending past his shoulders. He is wearing a black coat with visible buttons down the center and a white cravat around his neck. The background consists of a dark oval frame with a plain backdrop. The image is bordered by a band bearing the inscription "The Rt Honble John Lord Sommers."

artworks.title: John, Lord Somers
artworks.artist: Jonathan Richardson, Sr.
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 28.1 x 23.4 cm (11 1/16 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The portrait depicts Lord Sommers facing forward, showing their head and part of the upper torso. The subject has curly hair, pronounced eyebrows, a broad nose, and a serious expression. They wear clothing with a high collar. The background is plain with faint lines, indicating aged or textured paper. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Johannes Witt
artworks.artist: John Smith after Werner Hassells
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing slightly to the right, with long curly hair, wearing a dark robe and a white cravat. The background is a dark oval frame with engraved text around the portrait. Below the image, there is more text in an elaborate script style.

artworks.title: Belisane and Parcival under the Enchantment of Urma
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after Henry Fuseli
artworks.medium: mezzotint in brown-black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features three figures. In the center, an elderly person sits on the ground with hands supporting their head, facing slightly left. They have a pensive expression and wear a long garment with a shawl over their head. To the right, a younger woman is depicted sitting with her head bowed. Behind her, another figure lies on a bed or dais, clad in a regal robe. Small ethereal figures are faintly present behind the elderly person. The background is a dark, draped curtain.

artworks.title: African Hospitality
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after George Morland
